fields.summary: Add coverage for baggage fee queries in flight booking domain
fields.customfield_11232:
Add support for baggage fee related queries in the flight booking domain.

Requirements:
- Add new intent: check_baggage_fee
- Support queries like:
  * "how much is checked baggage"
  * "what are the fees for carry-on bags"
  * "baggage fees for international flights"
  * "cost of oversized luggage"
- Add baggage_type non-terminal with canonical forms:
  * checked / checked bag
  * carry-on / carry on / hand luggage
  * oversized / oversized bag
  * sports equipment / sporting equipment
- Add minimum 15 unit test utterances
- Target accuracy: >92% on dev set

Acceptance Criteria:
- Grammar expands without errors
- All unit tests pass
- Minimum 15 test utterances covering all baggage types
- Manual spot checking confirms correct intent/slot extraction
